verdict.rationale: BILL documents a v3 REST API covering Spend & Expense, including managing transactions and reimbursements, with REST-style endpoints, recipes, and a sandbox. However, the only Spend & Expense auth evidence is an apiToken error message; nothing shows OAuth or scoped tokens, and receipt retrieval is never mentioned. Missing for 10: evidence of OAuth flows, scoped/least-privilege tokens, receipt/attachment retrieval endpoints, explicit expense-listing endpoint docs, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
